newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian Airlines names chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian Airlines names chief executive.

text.p: Bisrat Negatu has been named chief executive of national carrier Ethiopian Airlines, state television reported on Sunday.
The appointment took effective from July 11.
Bisrat replaces Ahmed Kelo, chief executive for the last three years, the television said.

Bisrat, who was head of corporate planning and has worked for the airline in various capacities for more than 20 years, can pick his administrative team and present it to the board for approval, informed airline sources said.
No details were given concerning Ahmed's departure.
